Join us in honoring your angel baby on Thursday, October 15, from 6:00 to 8:30 p.m. in room 102 on the lower level of the HopeWest Ferris Hospice Care Center.

This special evening will feature story time for children, a keepsake to take home, and light refreshments. This is a no-cost event, open to the public. Registration is encouraged but not required.

For more information or to register, call (970) 257-2390 or email [AdultBereavement@HopeWestCO.org](mailto:AdultBereavement@HopeWestCO.org).
